people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.
translations.bsb: “In that day the splendor of Jacob will fade, and the fat of his body will waste away,
